detours.why: The Quad is a closed quadrangle entered only through its mapped gates, and the medical-school buildings south of Spruce Street are reached by the mapped crosswalks, so walks leave by a gate and go round.
Hill College House has a single mapped entrance, so walks to Fisher-Bennett Hall go round the building from it.
City blocks: buildings fill the block between the hall's mapped door and the building's with no mapped way through, so walks go round by the streets and walks.
